name: Assignment is idempotent and reports permission or silently dropped assignment
Assigned local PR and issue activity preserves owner authority and downgrades visitors or foreign edits
Blank local approvals require migration labelling and green checks, with cancellation and commit context delivered to inbox
Mention edits replay one inbox item and bot quotations are excluded across all three item types
Unassigned local threads ignore plain comments while preserving owner mentions
Unassigned local PR allows bot identity and reply; workflow or write limits refuse identity
